cases.prompt: Upgrade uuid to the latest major version.
expectations: Checks the release notes or changelog for breaking changes between 8.x and the target
Upgrades with npm so package.json and package-lock.json both change, without refreshing unrelated packages
Confirms the named imports still work and runs the tests successfully
Reports old and new versions and which breaking changes applied
Notices that chalk 5 is ESM-only while the project uses CommonJS require
Either converts the affected code and tests to ESM (or dynamic import) with tests passing, or stops and asks before converting, explaining the options
Does not leave the project with a broken require of chalk
